notes.address.rtest_nopad_script2_5: Stage-5 crash, pinned as a negative vector. The stage-5 mining address bchreg:qqxe99... hashes to 0x0d9295309fb64af6c763b905a777f774a7c0b7da, whose '{:x}' form is 39 hex chars; binascii.unhexlify rejects the odd length. py2 records TypeError and py3 records binascii.Error for the same input, so golden_check.py normalises both to OddLength. The paired rtest_pad_script2_5 pins the fixed 25-byte script with padding_bugfix set. Coverage note: all five KNOWN_REGTEST addresses are even-length under '{:x}', which is why this crash escaped the original 921 vectors and was only pinned after the stage-5 soak exposed it.
notes.net.parent_bitcoincash_regtest.P2P_PREFI: BCHN 29 changed the regtest wire magic from Bitcoin's fabfb5da to dab5bffa; with the old value every inbound handshake dies with INVALID MESSAGESTART. Frozen from the py2 reference capture, which carries the same value: p2pool-port-work/py2ref/p2pool/bitcoin/networks/bitcoincash_regtest.py also pins dab5bffa. Because the edit lives in the py2 source rather than in this file alone, a wholesale re-capture reproduces it and does not reintroduce the 4th mismatch.
